shipping: Trench Store ships within the United States, including Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico. Shipping options and costs are shown at checkout.
Our apparel is printed to order. Orders typically ship within 2–4 days. Delivery time is additional and depends on the carrier and destination. We’ll email tracking when your order ships.
Please double-check your shipping address before placing your order. If you need to correct it or have a delivery issue, contact us through the store’s Contact page with your order number.
returns: Trench Store apparel is printed to order. We do not accept returns or exchanges for a change of mind or for a size or color selected at checkout. Please check your selections before ordering.

If your order arrives damaged, defective, misprinted, or different from what you ordered, contact us through the store’s Contact page within 30 days of delivery. Include your order number, a description of the issue, and photos if available. We’ll review the issue and follow up with next steps.
